standfirst: This issue covers OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol launch, new Claude whiteboard and sheet features, and a few skills you can try today.
digest: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra, a frontier model, and GPT-6.2 Sol, a cheaper everyday model, across ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API. It also launched ChatGPT for Sales, with a Sales plugin and more than 30 partner plugins. Google made Tasks in Gemini free in six countries and put Gemini 4 Hydrogen into Search worldwide.

Astra and Sol is the story clients will ask about, because OpenAI pitches better results with fewer tokens. Test that on your own tasks rather than trusting the launch claims. The Sales plugins and Astra for Law matter if you advise sales or legal teams, and Enterprise customers can request Law access.

Claude added whiteboard, sheet and data features, covered in two short videos and a longer walkthrough below. Claude Code shipped 2.1.326 and 2.1.327 with small safety and clarity fixes. To try something this afternoon, last30days-skill gathers research on a topic and book-to-skill turns a PDF into a skill. Read the thread behind the 40 percent search traffic claim before you repeat it to a client.

items.title: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol launch as OpenAI's new frontier and everyday models
items.summary: OpenAI's launch video for two models, one for hard projects and one for daily work, with fewer output tokens. Watch it before a client asks.

items.title: ChatGPT for Sales adds a Sales plugin and 30 partner plugins
items.summary: Short demo of preparing for calls, tailoring proposals and following up using customer context and sales tools inside ChatGPT. Useful for sales-team clients.

items.title: Claude can now turn ideas into visual whiteboards
items.summary: Short clip on Claude's new whiteboard feature, which lays out ideas visually. Worth a minute if you run workshops or brainstorms with clients.

items.title: Google Sheets has a new AI competitor
items.summary: A short clip on a new AI spreadsheet tool pitched against Sheets. Handy if your clients run reporting in spreadsheets.

items.title: Claude's new Whiteboards, Sheets and Data features: what you can do now
items.summary: Walks through which of Claude's new whiteboard, sheet and data features are actually useful, and whether to switch from Google Sheets.

items.title: One Revolut engineer built a code review service with Codex agents
items.summary: A senior platform engineer split the design into tasks for parallel Codex agents and reviewed the code. A vendor-made customer film.

items.title: Revolut's marketing team uses AI to tailor campaigns across 40 markets
items.summary: Revolut's global marketing head explains spotting local differences faster and why the team is told to challenge convincing answers. Useful for marketing clients.

items.title: How to build an AI operating system for your life
items.summary: Peter Yang walks through an AI chief of staff and automated workflows for email, scheduling and content. Good ideas to borrow for your own week.

items.title: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol arrive in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API
items.summary: Astra is the frontier model and Sol the efficient one, both claiming better coding and computer use at lower cost. This week's big client topic.

items.title: OpenAI adds a Sales plugin and 30 partner plugins to ChatGPT
items.summary: Covers prospect research, pitch prep and CRM updates inside ChatGPT. Check plan availability before you pitch it to a sales team.

items.title: Tasks in Gemini is free in six countries with deeper Workspace integration
items.summary: Gemini can now act on your behalf across Google Workspace, with new features starting in the U.S. Easy to try if your clients use Google.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.327 adds a confirmation before GitHub app installs
items.summary: Also keeps MCP server tokens off the command line and lists broken skill files in /status. Update as usual.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.326 lets Code Mode run with agent teams enabled
items.summary: Adds a startup warning for malformed tool permission rules and a message explaining why MCP servers stop loading after an admin adds a managed MCP config.

items.title: Astra for Law tops a legal evaluation across 24 areas of law
items.summary: OpenAI's own launch evaluation, so treat the ranking with care. Every ChatGPT Enterprise customer can request access, which matters for legal clients.

items.title: ChatGPT for Healthcare adds computer-use agents and healthcare plugins
items.summary: Agents can work across healthcare software, with improved clinical answers. Relevant for health clients weighing it against Google's Gemini for healthcare.

items.title: Google Search gets Gemini 4 Hydrogen worldwide
items.summary: Google is bringing the model to Search globally for more visual and intuitive responses. Expect clients to ask what that means for their traffic.

sections.title: Tools and skills you can use

items.title: last30days-skill researches a topic across Reddit, X, YouTube and the web
items.summary: A skill that gathers what people said in the last month and writes a grounded summary. Handy for client briefings, though it needs agent setup.

items.title: Anthropic updates its Word, PowerPoint and Excel skills with fixes
items.summary: Fixes to the skills behind Claude's document, slide and spreadsheet generation. A maintenance update, worth pulling if you use them in Claude Code.

items.title: book-to-skill turns a technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill
items.summary: Feed it a PDF and get a skill Claude can reference while you work. Useful for methodology books, though it needs Claude Code.

items.title: Composio's awesome-claude-skills collects skills and resources for Claude
items.summary: A browsable directory of skills for customizing Claude workflows. Good place to find ready-made helpers before building your own.

items.title: host-html MCP server publishes HTML as a shareable link
items.summary: Newly added to the MCP list. Lets an agent turn an HTML page into a shareable link, so test before sharing client material.

items.title: Karakeep is a self-hosted bookmark app with AI tagging and full-text search
items.summary: Saves links, notes and images and tags them automatically. Handy for a research library, though self-hosting needs some IT help.

items.title: Graphify turns codebases, docs and PDFs into a queryable knowledge graph
items.summary: A /graphify skill for Claude Code and other agents that maps files and how they relate. Useful for understanding a client's documents and code.

items.title: Blog post claims Google's AI answers cut search traffic by 40%
items.summary: A blog analysis with a busy Hacker News thread. Clients who depend on search traffic will ask, so check the figure first.

items.title: Harvard researchers find AI coding agents shift the bottleneck to code review
items.summary: Faster code generation moves the delay to review, a point 190 commenters debated. Useful when advising clients on where AI coding savings really land.

items.title: Microsoft introduces MAI Code 2 and Code 2 Flash
items.summary: Microsoft's own coding models, announced with a 332-point Hacker News thread. Worth knowing about if clients are Microsoft shops.
